question: How much will a sum of ₹72,000 become after one year if the interest is compounded half-yearly at 10% per annum compound interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹72,000

Rate of interest (r) = 10% per annum

Time (t) = 1 year

Compounded = Half-yearly

**Formula used:**

A = P × (1 + r/(n × 100))ⁿ×t

Where:

A = Amount, P = Principal, r = Rate of interest, n = Number of times interest is compounded annually, t = Time in years

**Calculation:**

A = 72000 × (1 + 10/(2 × 100))²×¹

⇒ A = 72000 × (1 + 10/200)²

⇒ A = 72000 × (1 + 0.05)²

⇒ A = 72000 × 1.05²

⇒ A = 72000 × 1.1025

⇒ A = ₹79,380

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
